note: Adapted from the English redescription of this species in Bacchus (1997); the alate and soldier are described in prose, with measurement tables; the large worker also has a description and measurements, not cited here. The original description is by Harris 1954. The author notes that the soldier labrum of this species is extremely densely setose dorsally, unlike the other species treated there, and that a seta on the front of the coxa is spine-like.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule orange-brown, with many yellow dots of unequal size scattered at the setal bases, frons paler; central spot, labrum and pronotum yellow, distinctly paler than the head; tibiae and tarsi yellow; antennae and abdominal tergites yellow, sometimes slightly paler than the pronotum, antennae brownish on both sides, segments 1 and 2 darker than the rest; anteclypeus yellowish white; sternites, coxae and femora pale yellow; wings pale yellow, costal vein yellowish brown. Posterior margin of head capsule arcuate, evenly rounded; setae numerous above the compound eyes, fewer behind them, the longest sometimes almost reaching the outer margin of the eye. A low ridge extends from the central spot to near the posterior part of the postclypeus. Frontal gland pore narrowly oval, slightly concave in front of the line joining the posterior margins of the compound eyes. Central spot oval. Trunk of the cranial suture clearly visible, the V-shaped part indistinct. Postclypeus elongate-bean-shaped, length distinctly greater than width, median longitudinal line weakly to moderately distinct. Compound eyes short-oval, ocelli long-oval; labrum length less than width, disc with a few setae; antennae 16-segmented, segment 1 larger than segment 2, segments 3, 4 and 5 equal in size and smaller than segments 1 and 2. Pronotum densely setose, almost as wide as the head capsule; anterior margin moderately concave, posterior margin straight; posterior margins of meso- and metanota in a deep broad V shape, median longitudinal line incomplete; tibiae and tarsi darker than the coxae and femora.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow, pale orange to orange; labrum yellow, deep yellow to orange; mandibles brown with yellow bases; antennae pale yellow, brownish on both sides; postmentum yellow, concolorous with the genae; thoracic nota, abdomen and legs pale yellow to yellow. Head capsule oval, slightly narrowing anteriorly, with numerous setae; labrum ligulate, apex extending past the middle of the mandibles, dorsally extremely densely setose (unlike the other species treated there); mandible apex strongly incurved, curvature 0.06—0.09 mm; antennae 14-segmented, segments 3 and 4 similar and slightly smaller than segment 5, segment 1 larger than segment 2, segment 2 larger than segment 3; postmentum short and broad. Anterior lobe of pronotum small, pointed, separated by a V-shaped median notch; posterior lobe large, semicircular, margin slightly concave. Fore tibia 0.13—0.15 mm wide, slightly inflated ventrally; spurs 3, the dorsal spur almost as long as the outer ventral spur; a seta on the front of the coxa spine-like.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate measurements (6 heads, 2 colonies, mm): head length to anterior margin of postclypeus 1.15—1.25, head width including compound eyes 1.25—1.33, postclypeus length 0.29—0.30, width 0.63, labrum length 0.38—0.40, width 0.48—0.53, maximum diameter of compound eye 0.35—0.40, minimum diameter 0.33—0.38, maximum diameter of ocellus 0.18—0.20, minimum diameter 0.13, distance from ocellus to compound eye 0.03—0.04, pronotum length 0.80—0.90, width 1.18—1.25, hind tibia length 1.38—1.43. Soldier measurements (18 heads, 14 colonies): head length including mandibles 1.40—1.63, head length to mandible base 0.90—1.04, head width behind antennal sockets 0.74—0.95, maximum head width 0.83—1.00, labrum length 0.30—0.35, width 0.23—0.28, left mandible transverse length 0.58—0.61, width 0.06, curvature 0.06—0.09, fore tibia length 0.55—0.63, width 0.13—0.15, hind tibia length 0.70—0.78, width 0.09—0.11, maximum pronotum width 0.54—0.60. Holotype soldier Tanzania (BMNH).
